svg.title: Rampage actual UI mock — boss

text.tspan: CLIENT • Toast • 25/25 monsters • 15 spectators • 40 total max
KEYS LIVE • WASD / arrows + SPACE • Esc releases
WASD / arrows to walk & climb • hold SPACE to punch • Esc releases keys
Climb towers in lanes 2, 4, 6. Smash each floor twice. Down to street; flatten all towers, then punch the boss.
Joined as player! Shared city, personal score. • Drag title to move • Close hides; Leave exits
